home.welcome: Welcome, {name}. Your account is built without a password.
home.googleSession: Google verified your identity for this session.
home.passkeyProof: A passkey replaces a shared password with a private credential on your device. You approve the sign-in with a fingerprint, face recognition, or screen lock, then your device creates a unique proof that only works for this application.
home.noSecretDescription: There is no password to leak, memorize, or accidentally reuse on another website.
home.siteSpecificDescription: The proof is bound to this domain, helping protect you from phishing pages that imitate a sign-in form.
home.authenticationDescription: This service verifies your identity with a passkey or a connected Google account, then creates a protected session for your device. Sensitive account changes ask for an additional identity check.
home.verifyDescription: Approve with your trusted device or Google.
home.protectDescription: Your session is secured and can be reviewed at any time.
home.recoverDescription: Recovery email and codes help you return safely.
home.openDescription: Passkeys are based on WebAuthn, a web standard from the W3C, and work with the FIDO Alliance approach to passwordless authentication. Browser and device platforms are adopting these standards so people can use one familiar approval instead of creating another password.
home.practicalSecurityDescription: Strong security becomes easier when the sign-in prompt is built into the device people already use.
home.lessFrictionDescription: Fewer reset flows and no password rotation help people return to their accounts with confidence.
home.visibleControlDescription: This account keeps sessions, connected Google access, and recovery methods in one place for review.
home.methodsCardDescription: Manage Passkeys and your Google connection.
home.sessionsCardDescription: Review devices with access to your account.
home.recoveryCardDescription: Keep recovery options ready when you need them.
